params.description: The ID of the group the deals belong to. Can be retrieved from the [List groups](/api-reference/groups/list-groups) endpoint.

params.name: objectType
params.description: The name of a deal custom field that can be retrieved from the [List group custom fields](/api-reference/groups/list-group-custom-fields) endpoint.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of items to return.

params.name: cursor
params.description: A cursor for pagination across multiple pages of results. Don’t include this parameter on the first call. Use the `pagination.nextLink` value returned in a previous response to request subsequent results.

params.name: combinator
params.description: The logical operator to combine multiple filters.

params.name: filter
params.description: A record of filters to apply, following the format `filter[attribute][operator]=value`. The `attribute` is the name of the attribute to filter on, and the `operator` is one of the supported filter operators. Refer to [Filterable fields](/api-reference/filtering#filterable-fields) to learn more about the supported attributes and operators.
